observations: No adaptive binning or keV binning is used in TB L1 / EC L2.

Gaussian is evaluated at bin centers; current models do not integrate the Gaussian over each bin.
Current saved default EC bin width is 4 ADC; custom process cfg.bin_width was not exposed through Workbench submit/execute at audit start.
EC background-channel candidate scoring used hard-coded 4 ADC before the current change; EC owner notified.
Legacy UI minimum fit-window span 8 ADC may contain fewer than 8 fit bins; minimum should follow bin width.
